profile.headline: Mobile Engineer
profile.summary:
iOS engineer with 12 years of experience building native mobile applications at scale. Currently at Samsung SmartThings, focused on AI/ML research (LLM training, on-device RAG) and driving platform modernization.

WHAT I DO 
I solve hard architecture problems and build the foundations that teams scale on. My work spans enterprise architecture selection, on-device ML integration, SDK design, CI/CD automation, and codebase modernization. I've led technical direction for applications serving 1M+ monthly active users and built engineering teams from the ground up.

WHAT DRIVES ME
Ambiguous technical problems where the right answer requires research, prototyping, and clear communication of trade-offs. Building scalable systems that hold up under real-world pressure. Growing engineers into stronger architects and more thoughtful reviewers.

TECHNICAL FOCUS 
iOS Architecture, SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, CoreML, Vision, On-Device RAG, LLM/GenAI, SDK/Framework Design, CI/CD Automation, Modular Architecture, Performance Optimization

When I am not coding you can finding me rock climbing, hiking, or camping. I like my beer hoppy, my food spicy, and my coffee black.

  ✉ ericcollom.dev@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Senior Software Engineer on the SmartThings iOS platform team at Samsung, driving AI/ML research initiatives and modern concurrency adoption across the organization.

• Led R&D for LLM adapter training across multiple chatbot use cases, evaluating tool calling and prompt engineering strategies and delivering a proof-of-concept application.

• Designed and implemented an on-device retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system for iOS and macOS, leveraging Apple's on-device LLM and NLEmbedding vectors while evaluating alternative open-source embedding models from Hugging Face
positions.insights: Skills: Core ML · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · iOS Development · iOS · Swift · SwiftUI · Edge Computing · Swift Concurrency · Large Language Models (LLM) · Prompt Engineering

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Skills: UIKit · Mobile Application Development · SwiftUI · Software Development · iOS Development · Core ML · Computer Vision · Edge Computing · Optical Character Recognition (OCR) · iOS

positions.title: Mobile Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Mobile Technical Lead for AARP's flagship iOS application serving over 1 million monthly active users.

• Led enterprise architecture selection by evaluating five competing patterns (RIBs, TCA, VIPER, iMVVM, MVVM+C) and drove team consensus on a modified MVVM+C approach that balanced simplicity, flexibility, and reduced onboarding overhead. Designed a UIKit/SwiftUI hybrid navigation strategy that preserved full navigation stack control while enabling incremental adoption of modern UI patterns across the codebase.

• Brokered cross-team alignment for a complex in-app purchase integration, defining service boundaries and producing implementation diagrams that enabled multiple teams to deliver collaboratively. Built proof-of-concept implementations to assess content delivery strategies, including document formats, deep linking, webview interception, and offline caching, and documented trade-offs for stakeholders across engineering and product.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · Mobile Application Development · SwiftUI · Software Development · iOS Development · Swift · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Code Review · Content Delivery · async/await · Software Architecture · In-App Purchase · Xcode Cloud · Team Building · Hiring · Technical Interviews · Mentoring · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Stakeholder Engagement · Cross-team Collaboration

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Built marketing iOS application to to bring in more customers. Used SwiftUI, RealityKit, SceneKit, Core Location, MapKit and HealthKit.

• Technical writing - wrote multiple articles covering topics such as actors, property wrappers, swizzling, and block chain data permanence.

• Maintained hybrid iOS and Android application built using Ionic, Capacitor, React, and Typescript.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · Mobile Application Development · SwiftUI · Software Development

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Consumer facing banking services application with over 100,000 users and 4.8 app store rating.

• Led feature teams consisting of QA, back-end, and front-end engineers. Answered questions around implementation details, removed blockers and assisted engineers in getting their job done.

• Team wanted to explore implementing new features in SwiftUI. Proposed solution to facilitate transition from UIKit to SwiftUI. This included styling, analytics and allowed for new SwiftUI code to be used in UIKit hybrid scenarios.

• QA team had trouble duplicating bugs due to lack of network logging. Refactored networking code to include request and response logging which redacted customer personal private information. Also, added logging for decoding errors. This helped QA rapidly identify sources of certain bugs.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · Mobile Application Development · SwiftUI · Software Development

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Helped build out core functionality and architecture of new flagship application.

• Application was having Core Data issues with efficiency, duplicate data creation, and schema design. Proposed a solution to fix schema design issues. This resulted in faster batch deleting, as well as removed edge cases where some objects could not be batch deleted. Additionally, cleaned up save code to be more concise and not duplicate objects.

• Client was losing customers due to legacy Objective-C application being hard to use. Implemented new simplified workflow, that was built using Swift, that tied into legacy Objective-C code. Team increased test coverage from 0% to 8% and implemented black box testing to assure changes to legacy code did not break old UI and workflow. Received positive feedback from users.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · UIKit · Mobile Application Development · Software Development

positions.title: iOS Mobile Developer
positions.description:
• Improved application stability and reduced bugs by adding unit tests to current code, wrote tests for reported bugs, and used dependency injection in order to facilitate testing new code.

• Improved application security before transitioning it from the B2B application store to the general store. Added API secrets along with obfuscation, masking, and honey pots.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · Mobile Application Development · Software Development
